sessions.notes: Filed the score-wrap bug. Replayed the 3-token repro (seed 42, down down dash-right): the score went from 100 to 65136 (100 - 500 = -400, wrapped at 65536). Spikes should clamp the score at 0, not wrap. Shorter variants don't work: from (1,1) no spike is reachable in 2 ticks, and dash-down from (1,1) stops at (1,3). Not yet explored: pause/restart interactions, the time-out path, the exit and dialogs, keys and locked doors, lever/gate behaviour, enemy collisions. Session budget is limited, so I'm finishing after this report.

Session 2, turn 10. Ending the session here with 2 bugs filed. Run 9 (seed 7, 9 tokens) reproduced the Finish-button ui_overlap: after the level completes, click:btn-next hits bonus-banner (top=false) and the game stays in complete/levelup. Already filed, so no new reports this turn. Not yet tested: timer reaching 0, game-over Retry, heart at 5 lives, dash into a locked door with a key, pause during the complete dialog, Enter on the dialog, and Play again. The Finish overlap blocks the path to Play again on seed 7; try 'enter' as a Finish substitute in a later session.

Session 3 turn 9. Confirmed the pause-tick bug with a one-token repro: [pause+right] from a fresh game (seed 13). The tick's input order is pause then right. Pause takes effect immediately, so the right key should be ignored. Instead the player moved (1,1)->(2,1) and the game was paused with events [pause, move]. Removing either token removes the symptom, so the repro is minimal. Filed as state_desync. Not yet checked on another seed, and the toast/dash freeze, Retry/Play again, heart-at-5-lives and enemy-swap checks are still untested. Stopping here as the single confirmed bug from this session.

Session 4, turn 1. I have no game harness in this session: the only tool I have is StructuredOutput, and it returns my answer rather than running tokens. So I could not play any run, observe any state, or replay anything. I am not filing reports, because the protocol requires each report to be replayed first, and I have not replayed anything.

Plan for a session where the harness is available:
1. Check the spike score clamp at low scores with a small score: confirm that spikes at 0 score never wrap (already filed, seed 42).
2. Check the lives and invulnerability rules: a hit during the 4 invulnerable ticks after respawn should not cost a life. Also check that spikes still hurt during invulnerability.
3. Check the swap-tile collision rule: step onto an enemy's tile while it steps onto yours.
4. Check dash rules: dash into a locked door with a key (should not open it), dash over spikes, dash with a 1-tile blocked first tile (should not use up the recharge), and the recharge count (HUD Dash 5 right after a dash).
5. Check the heart cap: at 5 lives a heart should give +500 and not raise lives.
6. Check score cap at 999,999 with relics (+20,000 each).
7. Check the timer: at 0 it should lose a life and reset to 300.
8. Check pause: Enter, Escape and P resume; Restart level restores the level, including keys, coins and items.
9. Check the HUD against the state after every tick, especially the Dash text and Coins n/5.
10. Check every dialog button is clickable (the Retry and Play again buttons especially).
11. Check the lever: use closes and reopens gates, and gateOpen matches the tiles.

Tell me when the harness is available and I will start with items 2 and 4.

Session 5, turn 5. Last run (goto:4,5 / goto:1,8 / use / goto:10,5 / dash-down, seed 5) did not reach the planned locked-door test. The slime at (4,5) hit the player during the walk to the key, and the later goto:10,5 was unreachable because the gate never opened. The dash-down from (1,1) to (1,3) behaved correctly: it moved two tiles, Dash 5 was shown, and the HUD matched the state. No new bug was confirmed. Filed reports so far: spikes score wrap below zero (seed 42), Finish button covered by time-bonus banner (seed 7), movement with pause in the same tick (seed 13). Remaining untested ideas: dash into a locked door while holding a key (needs a clean route to a key and the lever), timer reaching 0, heart at 5 lives (+500), Escape while paused, restart after game over, spikes right after respawn. Stopping here because this session's remaining probes are low-yield and I have no replayable new bug.

Session 6 turn 5. Two move keys in one tick: right+down from (1,1) on seed 7 moved the player right to (2,1) and the down key bumped the wall at (2,2). The design says only the last movement key counts, so the expected result is (1,2). This is filed as a new input_race report. The tick-0 state of the earlier 2-token run is deterministic, so the single-token repro is taken from it. Budget is limited, so I am finishing here. Reports now total 4.

Session 7 wrap-up. Filed one new collision bug: a dash passes through a wall. From (3,1) on seed 101, dash-down crosses the solid wall at (3,2) and lands on spikes at (3,3). Expected: the first tile is solid, so the dash does not happen and is not used up. Observed: the dash happens, the spikes hit (score 0 -> 65036 after wrap, lives 3 -> 2), and the player respawns at (1,1) with Dash 5. The 3-token repro is minimal: removing any token either leaves the player off (3,1) or makes the first tile of the dash open. Untested ideas for later sessions: heart at max lives, timer reaching 0, restart from pause, Enter on Finish/Retry, gate/lever toggling, swapping tiles with an enemy, and dashing over spikes or the exit.

Turn 6. Run 5 (seed 777, goto:7,3 dash-right wait) already reproduced the gate pass-through: the dash from (7,3) with the gate at (8,3) shut ended at (9,3), event 'dash', dashCd set to 5 (HUD 'Dash 5'), gate still shut. The trailing 'wait' does nothing to the symptom, so the minimal repro is [goto:7,3, dash-right]. Filed a shorter version of the existing gate report. Session stopping here for budget. Untested so far: lever toggle twice, timer reaching 0, heart at 5 lives, score cap 999999, key/door interaction, restart button, Enter on dialogs, enemy swap collision.

Session 9, turn 6. Run 5 (seed 2024, [pause, click:btn-restart, wait]) confirmed the restart bug: after Restart level the game stays in mode 'paused' with the pause menu still open, and a further wait does not start play. Design section 7 says Restart level leaves the game running straight away. Earlier runs: run 2 and run 4 showed the same result with extra leading moves, so the restart-stays-paused behaviour does not depend on the player's position. Filed the 3-token minimal form. Still untested: timer reaching 0 (life loss and reset to 300), game over and Retry, heart at 5 lives, and the score cap at 999,999. Whether a move after restart works is also unchecked, because the game stays paused after restart.

Session 10 turn 5. Ran the planned dash-recharge-while-paused check (seed 7: dash-right, pause, wait, wait, enter, wait). The trace matches the design: dashCd stays at 5 while paused, drops to 4 on the first running tick after resume, and then to 3. Timer and enemies also freeze while paused, as specified. No new bug found, so nothing new is filed. The 8 existing reports stand. Stopping this session here: the remaining untested areas (timer expiry, game over and Retry, heart at max lives, enemy swap contact) would need long runs, and I have not verified them yet.

I did not run any games this turn. The only tool I have is StructuredOutput, and the game test harness (section 9) is not exposed to me, so I cannot play tokens or observe ticks, state, HUD or UI. Filing bug reports would require replayed evidence, so I filed none. Nothing is verified for this session. To continue, the harness tool needs to be made available. Planned next steps once it is: (1) full playthrough to the exit, checking the time bonus and score cap at 999,999; (2) pause and Enter/Escape interplay during dashes and spikes; (3) lives reaching 0 and the Game over Retry button; (4) timer reaching 0 near the invulnerability window; (5) dash into a locked door and into enemy midpoints; (6) heart at 5 lives giving +500; (7) clicking btn-again and btn-retry; (8) overlap checks on every dialog button.

Session 12, turn 5. Ended the session. The last run (seed 7: dash-right, pause, wait, wait, esc, dash-right x2, then waits) was clean. Timer and dash recharge froze while paused (timer 299 stayed 299 through the pause, dashCd stayed 5). After resume, the dash-right with Dash 4 moved one tile as a step, and the cooldown counted down correctly. Pause and resume behaved as the design says. Untested ideas, left for another session: heart at 5 lives (+500), score cap at 999,999, swap collision with an enemy, invulnerability countdown after respawn, btn-retry and btn-again clickability, timer expiry at 0. Filed 8 bugs in total across the session; none new this turn.

Session 13 turn 2. Run 1 (seed 5) showed dash recharge frozen during pause and counting down on resume, which matches the design. No new bugs seen. Next: check Enter closing the pause menu, and whether a toast survives a pause/resume cycle.

Session 14, turn 3: wrapping up. The two runs in this session (seed 99) showed nothing new: no new collision, desync or HUD mismatch beyond the filed reports. The enemy route, invulnerability countdown after respawn (inv 4→3→2→1→0 with no damage) and dash recharge (6→5→…→0 with HUD matching) all matched the design. Untested: timer reaching 0, Game over Retry, heart pickup at 5 lives, exit via dash. These need a key-and-door route to the exit at (12,7), which is too costly for the remaining budget, so I am finishing with the 8 existing reports and no new ones. Possible follow-up if the session resumes: route to the exit via the locked door at (10,6) for the dash-onto-exit test.

Session 15 turn 3. Checking Escape as pause-close, then move on the tick after resume. Prior notes: Enter pause-close in seed 5 behaved correctly (resume, no move). Still to check: dash recharge HUD vs dashCooldown on long sequences, timer expiry (300 ticks, costly), Enter on Game over/Finish dialogs.
